name: GitHub Notifications
description: Review requests, mentions and other unread GitHub notifications in an Orca sidebar panel.

settings.title: Notify on review requests
settings.description: Desktop notification when someone requests your review. The panel lists these either way.

settings.title: Notify on mentions (you and your teams)
settings.description: Desktop notification when you or one of your teams is mentioned.

settings.title: Notify on assignments
settings.description: Desktop notification when an issue or pull request is assigned to you.

settings.title: Notify on comments
settings.description: Desktop notification for new comments on threads you follow.

settings.title: Notify on CI activity
settings.description: Desktop notification for CI runs, such as a failed workflow.
